longDescription: Independent ImageSlide GIF fork by ggazzeta, based on Santiago P?rez (MIT). Version 0.11.0 uses PNG-frame animation only, on-demand compositing/resizing, short-clip frame sampling, shared binary caches and bounded private disk storage. Folders and all information preferences are independent per profile. Windows x64 and macOS x64/arm64 dependencies are packaged and statically verified. Basic PNG playback was user-confirmed on one D200 with 0.9.0; native GIF froze. The 0.10.1 ownership fix is installed, and the new 0.11.0 pipeline has not been physically validated. Clock, WeatherAPI and system panels are preserved. Setup is a private profile technique with exact Windows build pins and preserved known-fork restore lineage; macOS users reopen Studio manually and the clock overlay can remain visible. No store submission or broad hardware-verified claim is made. Technique attribution: https://github.com/chilleno/claude-deck.
